question.worked_solution:
We replace $x$ with $6$ in the expression and simplify as much as possible.

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3(2x-4)}{4(5-x)} & = \\ \frac{3(2(6)-4)}{4(5-6)} & = \\ \frac{3(8)}{4(-1)} & = \\ \frac{24}{-4} & = \\ -6\end{aligned}
$$
